watch.summary: The streamer accidentally exits a game lobby while mods are downloading and dramatically laments having to restart the entire process.

beats.what: The streamer sits waiting while game mods download in the server lobby.
The screen unexpectedly kicks back to the main menu.
The streamer is confused and asks what happened.
He realizes he accidentally backed out while waiting.
He groans loudly and complains about having to restart the download.
He holds his head in hands in defeated silence.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Now I gotta start again? I mistakenly backed out!
watch.why: The clip relies on a universally relatable gaming mistake where a simple misclick undoes loading progress, prompting dramatic lamenting. While honest and mildly entertaining, it is a standard stream reaction without a unique punchline.
